errors.installer_proof_missing: the install came back without the installer's GitHub authorization, which this install requires
errors.unknown_permission: unknown permissions {name:%q} (supported: actions:write, deployments:write, workflows:write, checks:read)
errors.workflow_writes_disabled: workflows:write is disabled on this install (set {env}=1 to let agents change .github/workflows/)
errors.app_configured_by_env: app is configured via environment variables — update the deployment env instead
errors.run_key_required: only an agent run's key may read this credential
errors.internal_not_for_sessions: internal endpoints serve agent runs and their MCP servers, not browser sessions
errors.key_scoped_to_other_task: API key is scoped to a different task
errors.key_task_not_in_project: API key is scoped to a task not linked to this project
errors.no_task_token: no token configured for any of this task's projects
errors.workflow_push_hint:
{cause}
(the branch changes .github/workflows/; Thulu mints that permission only with {env}=1)
errors.permission_not_granted: this run may not mint a GitHub token with {name}: its stage does not grant {server} any of the tools that need it ({tools})
errors.delegated_permission_held: a delegated chat never gets a GitHub token with {name}: what needs it (approving a deployment, merging a pull request) waits for the person the chat acts for to confirm it
errors.delegated_needs_app_token: this project reaches GitHub through a stored credential, and a delegated chat only gets GitHub App installation tokens: a stored credential carries everything its owner gave it and cannot be narrowed to what the chat may do. Connect the project to the GitHub App installation.
errors.repo_invalid: repo must be owner/name or a repository URL, got {repo:%q}
errors.repo_not_in_workspace: no project in this workspace has the repository {repo}
errors.chat_tool_not_granted: this chat's stage does not grant {server} the {tool} tool, so it cannot ask for that
errors.needs_confirmation: this route only runs a delegated chat's request after the person it acts for confirms it in the chat
errors.pr_number_invalid: {number:%q} is not a pull request number
errors.run_id_invalid: {id:%q} is not a workflow run id
errors.merge_method_invalid: merge_method must be merge, squash or rebase, got {method:%q}
errors.review_state_invalid: state must be approved or rejected, got {state:%q}
errors.no_reviewable_environment: run {run} waits on no environment the GitHub App may review
errors.app_already_configured: a GitHub App is already connected: forget it before creating another

audit.installation_claim_refused: refused a claim on GitHub installation {id} ({account}): another workspace holds it
audit.installation_installer_refused: refused a claim on GitHub installation {id} ({account}): GitHub user {login:%q} cannot see it
audit.installation_reassigned: operator moved GitHub installation {id} from workspace {from:%q} to {to:%q}
audit.delegated_token: {agent} got a GitHub token for {project} acting for {person} ({permissions})
audit.app_registered: registered GitHub App {slug} (id {app_id}) from a manifest

hints.resolve_conflicts: Edit the listed files to resolve conflicts (remove <<<<<<< / ======= / >>>>>>> markers), then call `commit` and `branch_push` again. The rebase will be retried automatically.
hints.commit_in_terminal: in Kubernetes the changes are in your own clone: commit them with `git commit` in your terminal, then `git push`
hints.push_from_terminal: Thulu publishes what you pushed with `git push` from your terminal; commits you have not pushed are not included

log.setup_sync_suspension_failed: github setup: sync suspension for installation {id}
log.workflow_check_failed: check task branch {branch} for workflow changes (pushing without the workflows permission)
log.resolve_push_credential_failed: resolve github credential for project {project} (pushing tokenless)
log.webhook_unattributed: github webhook: dropped a {kind} event from installation {installation}: no workspace claimed it
log.manifest_convert_failed: github manifest: exchange the code for the App's credentials
log.manifest_validate_failed: github manifest: check the new App {app_id}
log.manifest_store_failed: github manifest: store the new App {app_id}
